title: NLP-LTU at SemEval-2023 Task 10: The Impact of Data Augmentation and Semi-Supervised Learning Techniques on Text Classification Performance on an Imbalanced Dataset
base_benchmarks: SemEval-2023 Task 10: Explainable Detection of Online Sexism (EDOS)
findings: The paper's findings are focused on sexism detection, data augmentation, and model performance. There are no findings related to religion as it was not a subject of the study.
